meaning:
βρύχω (Attic, βρύκω),
[in LXX: Job.16:10(9), Psa.34 (35):16 36 (37):12 111 (112):10, La 2:16 (חרק)* ;]
1. to bite or eat greedily.
2. to gnash, grind, with the teeth: Act.7:54.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
